# ethereum-optimism/optimism Weekly Report (Mar 29 - Apr 1, 2026)

## 🚀 Highlights
This week, the Optimism ecosystem made significant strides toward Interop readiness, headlined by the migration from legacy `FaultDisputeGame` types to the new `SuperDisputeGame` framework. Development heavily focused on the "Kona" fault proof stack, with `op-e2e` tests transitioning to `CANNON_KONA` and the introduction of a directory-based KV store for improved preimage handling. While the team successfully stabilized several long-standing flaky acceptance tests, new challenges emerged regarding output root mismatches and race conditions in the supernode's derivation pipeline, which remain the primary focus for upcoming sprints.

## 🛠️ Key Developments

### Superchain Interoperability & Dispute Games
The project reached a major milestone in decentralized governance and security by enabling the migration to `SuperDisputeGame` types, gated by a `DevFeature` flag ([#19253](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19253)). This work allows for individual chain upgrades via `OPContractsManagerV2`, providing the flexibility needed for the Superchain's evolution. Additionally, `op-reth` was updated with a wrapper to drop interop transactions following a reorg, preventing invalid cross-chain message references ([#19814](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19814)).

### Kona & Fault Proof Evolution
The "Kona" stack saw intensive refinement this week:
- **Test Migration:** All `op-e2e` fault proof tests were converted to use `CANNON_KONA` and `SUPER_CANNON_KONA` game types, replacing `op-program` with `kona-host` ([#19791](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19791)).
- **Data Handling:** A new directory-based KV store was introduced for `op-program` compatibility ([#19803](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19803)).
- **Message Expiry:** Kona's `MessageGraph` now uses a configurable expiry window rather than a hardcoded constant ([#19765](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19765)), and the `depset` configuration was integrated into the super executor to detect expired messages ([#19849](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19849)).

### Infrastructure & Node Stability
- **`op-conductor` Resilience:** A new Raft configuration prevents node shutdowns when a node is removed from a cluster, enhancing operational uptime ([#18699](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18699)).
- **Derivation Fixes:** Critical bugs in the derivation pipeline were resolved, including a fix for incorrect system configurations during `kona` resets ([#19792](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19792)) and ensuring deposit transactions are correctly extracted via `L2Transactions` hints ([#19850](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19850)).
- **Resource Management:** Fixes were applied to `op-node` to prevent panics by guarding `SafeDB` methods against use after closure ([#19824](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19824)).

## 🐛 Issues & Triage

### Closed Issues
- **Flaky Test Resolution:** A concerted effort successfully stabilized several critical tests, including `TestPreinteropFaultProofs_VariedBlockTimes` ([#19804](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19804)), `TestEthSimulateV1` ([#19836](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19836)), and various database resync tests ([#19661](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19661)).
- **Design & Security:** The design for the Shared Dispute Game was finalized and closed ([#19651](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19651)), and a Semgrep rule was implemented to enforce the "no-storage-variables" convention in `L2ContractsManager` to prevent proxy collisions ([#19391](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19391)).

### New & Active Issues
- **Kona State Mismatches:** A high-priority issue was opened regarding an output root mismatch in `kona` after deposit-only block replacement ([#19848](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19848)).
- **Supernode Logic:** Concerns were raised about the supernode's activity algorithm potentially invalidating data if the initial database block is unexpected ([#19841](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19841)).
- **Protocol Alignment:** A request was made to support EIP-7843 `slot_num` in the OP Stack's `BlockEnv`, which is currently hardcoded to zero ([#19853](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19853)).

## 💬 Community & Collaboration
The week was characterized by high-velocity troubleshooting between maintainers, particularly regarding the "Kona" executor and CI stability. Significant collaboration was evident in the rapid identification and patching of race conditions in the fault proof L1 head capture ([#19805](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19805)). Documentation also received a boost from external perspectives, including the integration of the Coinbase Kona security review ([#19811](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19811)) and expanded technical architecture guides for historical proofs ([#19790](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19790)).
